name: Readiness (Thaumaturgy (Path of the Focused Mind), Basic)

system.description: The thaumaturge jumpstarts her own sluggish synapses, gaining a quicker and more lucid understanding of a situation. This power may only be used on herself, granting a three-Trait bonus on Mental Challenges relating to leaps of logic, investigation, memory or reasoning. It lasts from one scene up to an hour.
